---
title: "Data & code"
---

Every figure on Ireland by Numbers is built from public data by code in the [irelandbynumbers.ie repository](https://github.com/irelandbynumbers/irelandbynumbers.ie). The data belongs to its publishers and keeps their licences.

Each dataset is listed here, with its publisher, the pages that use it and when it was pulled, as projects are added.

## Code

- [`analysis/`](https://github.com/irelandbynumbers/irelandbynumbers.ie/tree/main/analysis): one folder per project, with the scripts that fetch the data and draw its figures.
